lage: Your boss. Friday, 4:50 p.m. You want to leave at five. You've stayed late on plenty of Fridays.
brandt.open: The Kessler proposal has to be complete first thing Monday. Get it finished today.
A: Today? If you plan things this late, that's not my problem.
A.reply: I plan the way the clients plan. And you work here.
B: It's ten to five, and I've got plans tonight.
B.reply: I know it's ten to five. Kessler doesn't.
C: Is this about making sure Kessler doesn't find any mistakes?
C.reply: …Yes. He found two mistakes in the last proposal. That's not happening to me again.
D.note: She turns back to her screen.
E: I'll do the rough version by six and the rest by ten on Monday. Would that work?
E.reply.afterC: I really wanted all of it first thing Monday. …All right. The rest by ten, no later.
E.reply: No. First thing Monday means first thing Monday.
F: Is this all getting a bit much for you right now?
F.reply: I don't need therapy. I need the proposal.
G: What exactly has to be ready first thing Monday for Kessler to be happy?
G.reply.afterE: …The prices. If they're right, the text can wait until ten on Monday. Then go.
G.reply: The prices. The text can wait until ten on Monday. Do the prices, then go.
H: You can't keep springing this on me every Friday.
H.reply: …Fine. Go. But I won't forget this.
I: I've got concert tickets. This matters to me.
I.reply: Good for you. I still want the proposal on my desk first thing Monday.
inner: My boss asked me if I still have Kessler under control. I'm not sure I do.
cost.E: You stay until six for the rough version.
cost.G: You stay late today for the prices.
cost.H: You leave. But she won't forget it.
cost.I: You don't know if there'll be trouble on Monday.
ui.title: Tip of the Tongue
ui.tagline: Someone wants something from you, and you're working out what to say.
ui.help: Afraid, or facing violence? There is help in your country.
ui.inner: What she thought and didn't say:
ui.noRight: There's no right answer. This is what it cost:
ui.helpSafe: Afraid, or facing violence? You owe no one understanding. Safety comes first.
